title: Time to Opening Range Break
summary: The opening-range break rate, read through the minutes-from-open-to-first-break distribution attached to the result. The denominator is sessions with a formed range; the clock is computed over breaking sessions only, so a fast median break coexists with however many sessions never broke — read the two together. Direction and any composed condition reshape both the rate and the clock.
deltas: median and quantile break times, not a single average
any derived window works — the clock is per-window, not one-size
rate and clock arrive in one envelope with the same N
